name: LifeOS - Life Companion
subtitle: Your AI life companion
shortDescription: Free with ads. Remove ads anytime with the one-time Remove Ads purchase.
longDescription:
LifeOS is your all-in-one life management super-app — powered by Zoe, your AI life guide. From health tracking to financial planning, mental wellness to legal
  documents, LifeOS covers every stage of life in one unified platform.

### Disclaimer
HEALTH & MEDICAL: LifeOS is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Health, nutrition, fitness, and medication content
  is for informational purposes only. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making health-related decisions or changing medications.

MENTAL HEALTH: Mental wellness, mood tracking, and stress management tools are for self-care purposes only and are not a substitute for professional mental health
   treatment. If you are in crisis, contact emergency services or a licensed mental health professional immediately.

FINANCIAL: Budgeting, investment, tax, and financial planning tools are for personal tracking purposes only and do not constitute financial, investment, tax, or
  accounting advice. Consult a licensed financial advisor for professional guidance.

LEGAL: Legal templates, document guidance, and estate planning tools are for general informational purposes only and do not constitute legal advice or create an
  attorney-client relationship. Laws vary by jurisdiction. Always consult a licensed attorney for legal matters.

EMERGENCY & FIRST AID: Emergency and first aid content is for general guidance only and is not a substitute for professional emergency care. In any emergency,
  call your local emergency services immediately.

AI CONTENT (ZOE): Responses generated by Zoe are AI-generated and may not always be accurate. Do not rely solely on AI-generated content for medical, legal,
  financial, or emergency decisions.

### Ai & External Services
Zoe only connects to third-party AI services (Gemini, Groq, Anthropic) with your explicit permission. No external connections are made without your consent. All
  personal data is stored locally on your device only — never on our servers. You may configure your own AI key in Settings. The app works fully offline without
   any AI connection.
whatsNew: Ads now appear in the free parts of the app. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns them off (Restore Purchases is in Settings). Bug fixes and improvements.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
